chunks: That mansion is the Hereafter; We shall give it to those who do not want to be haughty in the land and spread corruption. The future belongs to those who take heed for themselves and follow the straight path.

key_terms.الدَّارُ الْآخِرَةُ: The Hereafter / The Abode of the Hereafter
key_terms.عُلُوّاً: Haughtiness / Exaltation (in a negative, arrogant sense)
key_terms.لِلْمُتَّقِينَ: For the God-conscious / For the pious
key_terms.وَالْعَاقِبَةُ: The final outcome / The end result

ai.seo_question: Who inherits the Hereafter according to the Quran?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the spiritual prerequisite for inheriting the Hereafter: humility and the absence of moral corruption (fasad), contrasting with the arrogance of Pharaoh. It underscores that true success is reserved for the Muttaqin, linking ethical conduct in this world directly to eternal reward.
